title: Entanglement-swapping measurements for deterministic entanglement distribution
summary: Entanglement swapping is a key primitive for distributing entanglement over quantum networks, but different measurement outcomes can produce end-to-end states with different entanglement, requiring branch-dependent processing or the rejection of unfavorable outcomes. We characterize all projective swapping measurements with full-Schmidt-rank vectors such that, for every pair of pure input links, all outcomes yield the same end-to-end state up to local-unitary corrections.
